visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a pink top and light blue cardigan, smiles and poses in an outdoor setting with dense green trees in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit tire shop interior where the woman points to a Michelin tire on a display rack, her expression is animated as she speaks to the camera. (3) A male technician wearing a face mask is briefly seen working on a car wheel as the woman stands nearby, gesturing towards the tire. (4) The woman holds a large, round beige carrying bag with the Michelin logo in front of a green screen-like wall in the shop. (5) Inside a car cabin, the woman wears a seatbelt and talks directly to the camera while the car is in motion; rain is visible on the windows. (6) Back in the outdoor wooden deck area, the woman unzips the large bag, and a beige pop-up tent quickly unfolds into shape. (7) Three young women sit together inside the large beige tent, smiling and making hand gestures toward the camera.

The speaker's arousal level increases with an excited 'Oh!' exclamation. (5) The track ends with a final musical flourish and a friendly closing statement from the speaker.
